title: JEERE fiche boutique, version 1
description: The store config ('fiche boutique') that the JEERE assistant fills, the editor edits and the templates render. Source of truth for ids, labels and limits: data.js (window.JEERE_DATA). This schema checks structure, enums, ranges and the editor's character limits. Quality rules (empty store name, no payment method, fewer than 3 products, missing WhatsApp number...) are checked by JEERE_DATA.validate(), not here. Unique section and product ids cannot be expressed in JSON Schema: code checks them (normalizeConfig fixes them).

sections.description: Ordered list of page sections. The header and the footer are always rendered and are not sections. Ids 's1', 's2'... must be unique (checked by code).

products.description: The catalogue, in display order. Ids 'p1', 'p2'... must be unique (checked by code).

nicheId.description: fashion: Mode et vêtements · hair: Perruques et mèches · beauty: Beauté et soins · jewellery: Bijoux et accessoires · shoes: Chaussures et sneakers · food: Alimentation et traiteur · home: Maison et déco · crafts: Artisanat.

paletteId.description: Sable, Karité, Lagune, Hibiscus, Indigo, Mangue, Menthe, Nuit. The colours themselves live in data.js (contrast-checked); a fiche only names the palette.

fontPairId.description: Éditorial (Playfair + Inter), Moderne (Montserrat + Inter), Doux (Onest), Audacieux (Unbounded + Inter), Classique (EB Garamond + Fira Sans), Simple (Poppins).

artKind.description: Built-in product illustration used when there is no photo. French labels in JEERE_DATA.ART_LABELS.

image.description: null, or a photo uploaded by the seller as a base64 data URL (the editor downsizes it to a JPEG at most 800 px wide). The assistant never sets images.

fcfa.description: Whole amount in FCFA, no separator and no currency (6500, not '6 500 FCFA'). Code formats it for display: 6 500 FCFA.

name.description: Store name, shown as the text logo. validate() reports an error when it is empty.

whatsapp.description: '' or an international number such as +2250707123456 (code normalises it: digits only, +225 added when there is no prefix, leading 0 kept). validate() warns unless it matches ^\+\d{8,15}$.

niche.description: What the store sells, or null.

radius.description: Droit (0 px), Doux (10 px), Rond (22 px).

buttons.description: Plein (accent background) or Contour (1.5 px accent border).

payments.description: Payment methods shown in the footer as plain text (never the operators' logos or colours). validate() reports an error when none is true.

name.description: validate() reports an error when it is empty.

category.description: Free text. The Catégories section builds its tiles from the distinct non-empty categories, in order of first appearance.

description.description: One or two sentences: material, size, use.

type.description: announcement (Bandeau d’annonce), hero (Grande bannière), categories (Catégories), products (Produits), about (À propos), reviews (Avis clients), delivery (Livraison), whatsapp (Commander sur WhatsApp).

enabled.description: false hides the section without losing its settings.

settings_announcement.description: Bandeau d’annonce: one short sentence at the very top.

settings_hero.description: Grande bannière. Without an image, the template draws a composition from the first product's illustration.

settings_categories.description: Catégories: the tiles come from the products' categories; only the title is set here.

settings_products.description: Produits: the grid. Phone always shows 2 columns.

columns.description: Columns on desktop (a number, not a string).

settings_reviews.description: Avis clients. validate() warns when the section is shown with fewer than 2 reviews.

name.description: First name and commune, e.g. 'Mariam, Cocody'.

settings_delivery.description: Livraison: zones (communes) and their fees. validate() warns when the section is shown with no zone.

fee.description: Delivery fee in whole FCFA (1500, not '1 500 FCFA').

settings_whatsapp.description: Commander sur WhatsApp: the call to action. The button opens the store's WhatsApp number.
